description: Desktop 1280x720: the dark-theme switch of 07 alone (a click on an empty canvas point, then Alt+Shift+D) followed by a root-style and app-state read-back, with no capture. Added for R-76, so that a fresh session can run 15 straight after 00. 15 then does not start from the end state of 07b: the scene, scroll and style defaults that 01 to 07b leave are not set up. Requires 00 first in the session (the only emulate step).
